project_title: Cat Versus Ghost - Game UI & Design Guidelines

game_concept.genre: Tower Defense / Lane Defense / Strategy Casual
game_concept.theme: Nighttime Garden, Glowing Moonlight, Cute Cats vs Spooky Ghosts
game_concept.story: Pada malam bulan purnama, para hantu keluar dari dunia roh untuk mencuri energi kehidupan dari rumah manusia. Sekelompok kucing penjaga malam bertugas menghentikan gelombang hantu di halaman rumah sebelum mencapai pintu.
game_concept.core_loop: Kumpulkan energi Moonlight (+25) dari langit atau Solar Cat -> Panggil & tempatkan Kucing di jalur grid -> Bertahan dari gelombang Hantu -> Kalahkan Boss King Phantom Catnapper

visual_enhancers.hud_styling: Chunky rounded pill headers with 3D drop shadows, solid borders, semi-transparent frosted backs (bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-md border-2 border-amber-400/80 rounded-2xl p-2 sm:p-3)
visual_enhancers.lawn_grid_styling: Alternating checkerboard tiles (lawn_dark / lawn_light) with inner highlight shadows, green glowing outline when tile is hover-selected for cat placement
visual_enhancers.moonlight_orb_effect: Glowing pulse animation (animate-bounce + shadow-[0_0_20px_#fde047]), click pops floating '+25' text up and fades out
visual_enhancers.cat_mood_indicator: Small floating mood bubble over cat head: 😊 Happy (+20% Dmg), 😡 Marah (Faster Atk), 😴 Mengantuk (Slow Atk). Give snack to improve mood!
visual_enhancers.boss_health_bar: Top centered thick health bar with glowing purple frame, menacing boss portrait, and skill alert popups ('GHOST STORM!', 'POSSESSION!', 'DARK MOON!')
visual_enhancers.mobile_landscape: Forces landscape orientation or shows playful full-screen modal: 'Putar Layar ke Landscape untuk Pengalaman Main Terbaik 🐱✨'

ghosts_catalogue.name: Invisible Ghost
ghosts_catalogue.desc: Hanya terlihat oleh Ghost Hunter Cat

ghosts_catalogue.name: King Phantom Catnapper
ghosts_catalogue.desc: Boss utama dengan skill Ghost Storm, Possession, & Dark Moon

sound_effects_webaudio.engine: Web Audio API (Synthesized SFX without external asset lag)
effects: orb_collect: sine wave sweep (800Hz to 1200Hz, fast decay)
cat_place: gentle thumping pop + meow sound synthesis
laser_shot: high frequency saw tooth zapping tone
boss_skill: ominous rumble + deep synth frequency drop

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript / JSX files (.js / .jsx) as configured in this repository.
Ensure all text is in friendly Indonesian language (e.g., 'Kumpulkan Energi Bulan', 'Tempatkan Kucing', 'Gelombang Hantu Mendekat!').
Provide high responsiveness on both Desktop and Mobile landscape (touch drag/click cat placement).
Persist story progress, unlocked cats, and high scores in localStorage and connect endless high scores to backend leaderboard.
Strictly follow the data-testid conventions for reliable automated tests.
Do NOT use transparent dropdowns or header overlays that compromise legibility over dark garden backgrounds.
